mergeDump.name: Merge / Dump Party
mergeDump.hint: Merge the selected tokens into a group, or dump the selected group token back onto the scene.

dumpPlacement.name: Dump placement
dumpPlacement.hint: How member tokens are positioned when a group is dumped.
dumpPlacement.ring: Fan out around the group token

groupVision.name: Group token vision
groupVision.hint: Give friendly (party) group tokens token vision so players can see while travelling.

aggregateHpBar.name: Aggregate party HP bar
aggregateHpBar.hint: Drive the group token's health bar from the summed HP of its members.

autoMacro.name: Create hotbar macro
autoMacro.hint: Create a reusable "Merge / Dump" script macro the first time the world loads.

defaultPartyImage.name: Default party token image
defaultPartyImage.hint: Optional image used for new group tokens. Leave blank to use the first member's token art.

partyPortrait.name: Party portrait image
partyPortrait.hint: Actor portrait for friendly (party) groups. Leave blank to use the bundled default.

partyToken.name: Party token image
partyToken.hint: Token art for friendly (party) groups. Leave blank to use the bundled default.

enemyPortrait.name: Enemy portrait image
enemyPortrait.hint: Actor portrait for hostile / neutral groups. Leave blank to use the bundled default.

enemyToken.name: Enemy token image
enemyToken.hint: Token art for hostile / neutral groups. Leave blank to use the bundled default.

notifications.gmOnly: Only the GM can merge or dump party groups.
notifications.selectTwo: Select at least two tokens of the same disposition to merge.
notifications.mergeFailed: Could not create the group — see the console for details.
notifications.dumped: Dumped {count} tokens back onto the scene.
notifications.dumpFailed: Could not dump the group — see the console for details.
notifications.ejectFailed: Could not eject that member — see the console for details.
notifications.skippedCombat: Tokens already in combat were skipped to avoid breaking the tracker.
notifications.skippedSingletons: A disposition with only one selected token was skipped.
notifications.noLiveActor: This member is an unlinked token snapshot with no character sheet to open.
